axes.name: inventory_hard_cap
axes.mutation: Tune max_abs_inv (40–200) and inv_soft_cap (~25–45% of hard). Inventory drag is the known killer.

axes.name: widen_spread
axes.mutation: Raise spread_frac (0.65–0.95) and/or min_half_spread; fewer fills, less adverse selection.

axes.name: shrink_size
axes.mutation: Lower size_mult (0.7–1.3) and low_pool_size_frac; smaller clips limit inventory per fill.

axes.name: skew_aggressive
axes.mutation: Raise skew_bps_per_share (0.15–0.60) to lean harder against inventory.

axes.name: seed_fed_iran_only
axes.mutation: Set market_allowlist_mode='fed_iran'; keep tight inventory caps.

axes.name: pull_size_after_adverse_fill
axes.mutation: Tune inv_pause_ticks and pull_size_mult after inventory growth.

axes.name: min_edge_vs_bbo
axes.mutation: Raise min_edge_vs_bbo (0–0.02) to sit farther from touch.

axes.name: size_by_reward_pool
axes.mutation: Tune min_daily_reward_pool + low_pool_size_frac; keep enforce_pool_allowlist True.

axes.name: pause_after_fill
axes.mutation: Tune inv_pause_ticks (3–32) to pause adding side longer after inventory growth.

axes.name: vol_regime_filter
axes.mutation: Tune vol_filter and vol_lookback to skip high short-horizon vol.

axes.name: two_sided_strict
axes.mutation: Toggle two_sided_strict and skip_extreme_tails; keep inventory soft caps tight.

axes.name: free_explore
axes.mutation: Any small multi-lever change favoring inventory defense / high-pool markets.

axes.name: min_daily_reward_pool_fine
axes.mutation: Tune min_daily_reward_pool in {100,125,150,175,200} with enforce_pool_allowlist True; keep inv caps defensive.

axes.name: near_mid_size
axes.mutation: Tune near_mid_size_mult (0.4–1.0) and near_mid_dist; shrink size near mid for live defense.
